_why: Files git itself writes into .git/hooks on `git init`. The agent image installs git and push-to-checkout.sample contains the word `fetch`, which FORBIDDEN_IDENT bans in agent source.
_rule: A hook is exempt from the SOURCE scans only when its bytes match one of these digests exactly. An edited hook diverges and is scanned like any other file. Absent or stale digests mean NO exemption: this fails CLOSED.
_source: Generated INSIDE the agent image base (node:22-bookworm-slim@sha256:83f487e0...), not on the build host, so the digests match the git the agent actually runs (bookworm's git differs from other versions, e.g. in fsmonitor-watchman.sample).
